notes: City of Lynchburg, VA — the Virginia INDEPENDENT CITY (FIPS 51680). Not Lynchburg TN (Moore County), and not the surrounding Campbell/Bedford/Amherst County land.

~30.2k shipped parcels from the city's own GIS open-data layer (mapviewer.lynchburgva.gov OpenData/ODPDynamic MapServer/41), the full assessor roll. Independent city, so the source layer is already city-only — no county clip. See run_lynchburg.py. ~31k parcels -> browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles/H3.

EXEMPT has one deliberate exception: the DAV classes (791/792/793/795) are disabled-veteran relief granted to the OWNER, not institutionally exempt land — all 259 carry normal market assessments and are kept. PUBLIC SERVICE CORPORATION (class 801, 135 parcels) IS excluded: every one has zero local value, being state-assessed by the VA State Corporation Commission.

Condos are MERGED, not hidden (skill §6b, run_olympia.py recipe): the assessor maps each condo UNIT as its own building slice (~360 sqft residential, ~700-3,000 sqft office) carrying the unit's land-value share, while the development's real land is a separate 'COMMON AREA' parcel (108/499) at $0. Units are class 105 OR any parcel whose Legal1 says UNIT/CONDO — the assessor files townhome condos under 103/106, office/retail condos under 402/415/416/430 and DAV-relief condo units under 791. run_lynchburg.py groups units with their common-area lot by the Legal1 development name (PARKSIDE GRANDE, BLDG 1, UNIT 101 <-> PARKSIDE GRANDE, COMMON AREA; generic CONDO/CONDOMINIUM(S) suffix stripped; DOWNTOWN keys on the building) or by touching geometry, and collapses each group to one parcel (values summed, footprint = union with holes filled): 900 units + 39 common-area parcels -> 31 development parcels (27 Condominium, 4 Commercial office parks). Merged land $/sqft runs ~2x the surrounding parcels' median, as denser use should. Parcels whose legal says LOT (1,400 fee-simple townhouse lots and the Town Center at Wyndhurst shop lots inside HOA common areas) own their small lots and are deliberately NOT merged. 18 detached 'villa' condos on real-sized lots stay individual. hideRemnants stays on for the 13 genuine sub-500 sqft slivers left.

~205 HOA 'Common Area' parcels legitimately carry $0 land value (their value sits in the member lots) and appear in the gp-error layer. Accurate source data, not an ETL fault. (The 39 common-area parcels belonging to condo developments are absorbed into the merged condo parcels instead.)

Exempt filtering follows the assessor's class code, NOT an owner-name heuristic, deliberately: ~47 Liberty University and 3 Randolph College parcels are KEPT because they are the colleges' taxable commercial holdings (hotel, medical office, big-box retail), which Virginia taxes since exemption follows USE. A Baltimore-style ownership heuristic would wrongly delete ~$10M of land the city actually taxes.

Parking is OSM-only AND unclassified (--osm-only --no-classify), same as richmond: the surface-vs-structure classifier wedged on the Overpass fuel-station fetch on 2026-09-09, so surface_area_acres is 0 and the totals cover ALL parking (surface + structures). 2,747 polygons, 661.2 acres, $148.7M est. land value. Undercounts like every OSM-only city; the NAIP+ML path was not run. Re-run without --no-classify when Overpass cooperates — the classifier DID succeed once on 2026-08-29 (2,671 surface / 13 structure / 60 excluded / 3 uncertain).

link is the parcel-viewer ROOT, not a per-parcel deep link: the city moved to the CivQuest SPA (lynchburgva.civ.quest), which ignores URL query params (?parcel=/?search=/?q= all tested). The popup shows the Address, which is what its search box takes.
